subject: Acme MAP - Mutual Action Plan & Next Steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Acme MAP - mutual action plan & next steps

Hi Alex —

Thanks for taking the time today to walk through Acme's priorities. Quick recap from our side and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to keep momentum: 

Key pain points you called out:
- Token cost is ballooning across high-concurrency workloads; need to get unit economics under control.
- Latency spikes during peak hours are impacting product UX.
- Security/compliance review is required before Procurement can sign off (SOC2 + audit logs requested).

Goals you mentioned:
- Reduce per-user inference cost by ~30% while keeping latency below 300ms P95.
- Pilot in production-facing environment for a subset of customers by end of Q4.
- Keep data in a VPC-enabled deployment for regulated workloads.

Proposed MAP (high level):
1) POC kickoff (demo + baseline metrics) — Redwood + Acme engineering — target: week of Nov 6
2) Security questionnaire & evidence exchange — Acme security + Redwood security — target: responses by Nov 10
3) POC evaluation (performance, cost, quality) — joint testing — target: complete by Nov 24
4) Commercial review & procurement — Acme procurement + Redwood sales — target decision by Dec 8
5) Go-live & rollout plan — target Jan 5, 2027

Stakeholders you named on the call: Samantha Lee (CTO), Raj Patel (Procurement lead). Please confirm if any other stakeholders should be added.

Attachments: I attached a draft MAP spreadsheet for dates/owners (Acme-MAP-draft.xlsx) and the Redwood SOW template for procurement to review.

Next steps for this week:
- Can you confirm the stakeholder list and whether the Nov 6 kickoff window works?
- If Procurement needs an NDA before sharing invoices, I attached the signed NDA we already have on file.

Happy to jump on a short sync if you want to adjust timelines.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

[Attachment: Acme-MAP-draft.xlsx] [Attachment: Redwood-SOW-template.docx] [Attachment: NDA-signed.pdf]

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>

Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme MAP - mutual action plan & next steps

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the MAP. Confirming the stakeholder list below:
- Samantha Lee (CTO) — technical sign-off
- Raj Patel (Head of Procurement) — commercial sign-off
- I'll loop in Ops (TBD) during the POC kickoff.

A couple quick asks from my side:
1) Can you provide a pricing band for the POC (expected monthly token volume ~25M tokens) so I can flag to Procurement?
2) Is there a way to shorten the POC evaluation to 2 weeks if we scope it to the core user flows? We have a tight Q4 calendar.

Nov 6 works for a kickoff, but if we can move the POC evaluation window earlier that would be ideal. NDA is attached (signed by legal).

Appreciate it — likely we’ll be ready to move quickly once security answers come back.

Best,
Alex
Product Lead, Acme Corp
alex.johnson@acme.com
+1 (617) 555-0922

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme MAP - mutual action plan & next steps

Alex —

Appreciate the quick reply and for confirming stakeholders. I pulled the MAP into a slightly more detailed milestone list below with owners and target dates — we can compress the POC evaluation to 2 weeks if we tightly scope the test plan. I’ve flagged the reduced timeline in bold.

Updated MAP (dates/owners):
- Nov 6 (POC kickoff): Redwood SE + Acme Eng (Owner: Marissa / Alex) — kickoff demo, test plan, baseline metrics
- Nov 6–Nov 20 (POC execution — scoped): Redwood SE (Vivek) + Acme Eng — collect perf/cost/quality; **2-week scoped window to Nov 20**
- Nov 10 (Security questionnaire responses): Redwood Security (Neha) -> Acme Security (Samantha) — deliver SOC2 artifact, logging config, data residency notes
- Nov 22 (POC findings doc): Joint delivery of results and recommended config/quantization options
- Dec 8 (Commercial decision target): Acme Procurement (Raj) + Redwood Sales (Marissa) — finalize pricing & contract
- Jan 5, 2027 (Target go-live for initial cohort)

Deliverables from Redwood this sprint:
- Scoped POC test plan & runbook (Vivek) — sent by Nov 4
- Security evidence package (Neha) — sent by Nov 9
- POC results & cost model (Marissa) — Nov 22

Pricing band for scoped POC (estimate): $0.004–$0.006 per 1k tokens depending on batching/quantization choices. I’ll include a more detailed cost breakdown in the POC runbook.

I attached an updated MAP and SOW template (for procurement). If the timeline looks good I’ll send calendar invites for the Nov 6 kickoff and loop in the SE team.

Thanks,
Marissa
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the MAP and updated timeline. A couple of procurement/legal items from our side before Dec 8 decision: 
- Please confirm the invoice contact for Redwood and the legal entity name we should use on the contract.
- Can you share standard terms (we usually review your standard SOW/terms) and any SOC2 report redacted copy or authority to pull via SecureDocs?
- Would it be possible to include a limited SLA for uptime during the pilot window? Our security folks will ask about fallbacks if latency or model regressions occur in production.

If you can provide the invoice/legal info and the SOC2 pointer by Nov 9 that would help speed Procurement.

Regards,
Raj Patel
